verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਸੁਮੇਰ ਊਚ ਅਚਲ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਾਵਕ ਪਵਨ ਜਲ ਬਿਆਪ ਨ ਸਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau sumer uooch achal aga(n)m at paavak pavan jal biaap na sakat hai ||

en.bdb: As Sumer mountain is believed to be very high, immovable and inaccessible, it is least influenced by fire, air and water;

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਤਾਸ ਬਾਨੀ ਚਉਗਨੀ ਚੜ੍ਹਤ ਪਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਚਮਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: paavak pragaas taas baanee chauganee chaRhat paun gaun dhoor dhoor hoi chamakat hai ||

en.bdb: It shines and blazes in fire many times more while the air removes its dust making it glitter far more,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਗਮ ਸਲਿਲ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰੈ ਹਰੈ ਦੁਖ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਸੁਜਮ ਬਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)gam salil mal dhoi niramal karai harai dhukh dhekh sun sujam bakat hai ||

en.bdb: Water pouring on it makes it clean washing away all its dross. It dispels the distresses of the world by providing them with many herbs and medicinal plants. Because of all these virtuous qualities, people sing the glory of Sumer mountain.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਜੋਗੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਗੁਨ ਅਤੀਤ ਚੀਤ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਛਕਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੩੬੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise gur sikh jogee tiragun ateet cheet sree gur sabadh ras a(n)mirat chhakat hai ||360||

en.bdb: The mind of Sikhs, attached to their Guru, is free from the influences of maya and accumalates no filth. He is stable, pious, free of filth and relieves sufferings of others. They keep relishing the elixir-like Naam blessed to them by the Guru. (360)
